app_fee.value: A non-refundable A$100 fee is payable with every application for study as an international student.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable A$100 application fee is payable with all applications for study as an international student at UTS

fee_waiver.value: The application fee is waived only for current UTS students applying for a second degree, and current UTS College students applying for a UTS course.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is waived if you are a: | current UTS student applying for a second degree program at UTS

gre_general.value: The UTS pages checked do not mention the GRE General Test.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT overall 79 with writing 21 for most PhD courses; Health and Sustainable Futures courses need 94.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with writing 6.0 for Science, Engineering and IT PhD courses; Health and Sustainable Futures need 7.0.

english_waiver.value: Qualifications from India are not accepted as English-medium, so an English test score is required.
english_waiver.quote: the Medium of Instruction (MoI) option is not accepted for qualifications from India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Pakistan

notes: Faculty English rules differ (IELTS 7.0 and TOEFL 94 for Health, Sustainable Futures and Analytics research courses). The portal closes for new applications from 02 November 2026 until a new form opens in mid to late January 2027.
